name: Diblaim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: He took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, who conceived and bare him a son. He took a whore because it was symbolic of how the people committed spiritual fornication against the Most High.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea
